summary: Anchor the tool-error code match, and match stringified HTTP statuses.
reason: toolResultPayloadError matched a bare '_not_found' substring anywhere in a tool payload, so a tool that succeeded and returned text containing it — a docs search hitting a page about error handling, a code search returning a page_not_found identifier, a response listing an API's error codes — was reported as a silent tool failure. That is the same confident-but-wrong answer this command exists to correct, pointing the other way. The match is now anchored to a JSON code/error_code field. The HTTP status scan also missed the stringified form {"status": "404 Not Found"} and now trims the opening quote.
validated_outcome: TestToolResultPayloadErrorIgnoresHealthyPayloads covers three realistic false positives and fails against the unanchored match; detection of real failures is unchanged.
